mapper.select: select count(1) "document_count", sum(d.word_count) word_count, sum(d.tokens) token_count, sum(uf.size) file_size from (SELECT name, word_count, tokens, dataset_id, (data_source_info::jsonb)->>'upload_file_id' AS upload_file_id FROM documents where data_source_type='upload_file') d left join datasets ds on d.dataset_id = ds.id left join upload_files uf on d.upload_file_id = uf.id::text

select ds.id, max(ds.name) "name", 0 datasetCount, count(1) documentCount, sum(d.word_count) word_count, case when sum(d.tokens) is not null then sum(d.tokens) else 0 end token_count, sum(uf.size) file_size, '' type_code, '' type_name from (SELECT name, word_count, tokens, dataset_id, (data_source_info::jsonb)->>'upload_file_id' AS upload_file_id FROM documents where data_source_type='upload_file') d left join datasets ds on d.dataset_id = ds.id left join upload_files uf on d.upload_file_id = uf.id::text where ds.id is not null group by ds.id
